description: The plot illustrates how ACC (%) varies with Co-occurrence Number for multiple methods, shown as five colored line series. The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and uses a logarithmic scale with major ticks at approximately 10, 10², and 10³, spanning from roughly 1 to several thousand. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” on a linear scale, ranging from 60 to 85 with regularly spaced tick marks every 5 units. The Base series is a black solid line with circular markers, increasing from about 62.7 at the smallest co-occurrence value to about 68.7 at the largest. FT is a blue solid line with downward-triangle markers, rising from about 64.0 to about 70.7. IKE is a red solid line with upward-triangle markers, increasing from about 66.2 to about 72.4. MEND is a brown solid line with diamond markers, increasing from about 69.0 to about 77.0. MEMIT is a purple solid line with pentagon markers, increasing from about 68.2 to about 74.8. An additional green solid line with square markers is present, increasing from about 73.2 at the smallest co-occurrence value to about 81.5 at the largest, with intermediate points near 77.5 and 79.3.
